name: The Dime Notes
caption: OSW Online's own "cornerstones" of its Tag Team Division, wrestling through a Workshop-interference no-decision, a win over the Workshop, and a headline battle with Sexual Energy across the fed's first four cards.
notes: Ranked #2 in OSW's own Tag Team Title contender rankings and #4 in its own Most Popular poll (undated content, consistent with the fed's own March 2002 site state).

tenures.source: The fed's own served results page (5 Feb and 26 Feb 2002 cards), its own served video-library page (a 2 April 2002 tag battle with Sexual Energy, no result stated), and its own served 15 June 2002 news page, which names the team as part of a recent win. tenures.note: Billed on signing as the reigning OSW tag team champions; attacked backstage by Damien Legacy, then beaten down before a Tag Team Championship match by The Greatest Team Alive.

name: The Glam Boys
caption: A face tag team billed on OSW Online's own founding roster, losing to Sexual Energy and then the Workshop across the fed's first three cards.
notes: Ranked #5 in OSW's own Tag Team Title contender rankings (undated content, consistent with the fed's own March 2002 site state).

tenures.source: The fed's own served results page: lost to Sexual Energy on 26 February 2002 and to the Workshop on 19 March 2002. name: The Workshop
caption: A heel tag team that interfered in OSW Online's own opening-night Dime Notes match before beating the Glam Boys twice over the fed's next two cards.
notes: Ranked #3 in OSW's own Tag Team Title contender rankings (undated content, consistent with the fed's own March 2002 site state).

tenures.source: The fed's own served results page: interfered against the Dime Notes on 5 February 2002, lost to the Dime Notes on 26 February 2002, and beat the Glam Boys on 19 March 2002. name: Sexual Energy
caption: A self-declared "unofficial OSW Tag Team Champs" that beat the Glam Boys, headlined a tag battle with the Dime Notes, and later joined OSW Online's own Superiority Complex faction.
notes: Ranked #1 in OSW's own Tag Team Title contender rankings and #5 in its own Most Hated poll (undated content, consistent with the fed's own March 2002 site state). The fed's own served video-library page calls the team the unofficial "OSW Tag Team Champs" ahead of its own official tag title ever being awarded.

tenures.source: The fed's own served results page (beat the Glam Boys, 26 February 2002), its own served video-library page (a 2 April 2002 tag battle with the Dime Notes, no result stated), and its own served 15 June 2002 news page, which bills the team joining the Television Champion and Def Bellows in the "Superiority Complex.".
